questions.question: Which business model should be used when a company sells products or services directly to individual consumers without involving intermediaries?

explanation.correct: B2C (Business-to-Consumer) is the business model where a company sells products or services directly to individual consumers. In this model, the end customer is a consumer who interacts directly with the service provider.

wrongAnswers.explanation: B2B (Business-to-Business) is when companies sell to other businesses, not individual consumers
B2B2C involves a business selling through another business to reach consumers, involving intermediaries
B2B2E (Business-to-Business-to-Employee) is when businesses provide services to another company's employees

questions.question: In the B2B business model, which table is used to store information about companies that receive services?

explanation.correct: In the B2B model, the Customer Account table [customer_account] stores information about the companies (accounts) that receive services. Customer contacts are the individual people at those accounts.

wrongAnswers.explanation: The Consumer table is used in B2C models for individual consumers, not business accounts
Customer Contact stores individual people at accounts, not the company information itself
The User table stores internal users of the ServiceNow instance, not external customers

questions.question: Which plugin must be activated before installing Customer Data Models for B2B2C?

explanation.correct: The Customer Service Install Base Management plugin [com.snc.install_base] must be activated before installing Customer Data Models for B2B2C, as the B2B2C model relies on install base functionality to track products owned by consumers.

wrongAnswers.explanation: While CSM is required, it's not the specific prerequisite for B2B2C data models
AWA is for routing and assignment, not a prerequisite for B2B2C data models
Case Management is a core feature but not a specific prerequisite for B2B2C

source.excerpt: You must activate the Customer Service Install Base Management (com.snc.install_base) plugin before installing Customer Data Models for B2B2C.

questions.question: What is the purpose of install base management in Customer Service Management?

options.text: To manage the installation of ServiceNow plugins
To track products and assets that customers own or have installed
To configure the base URL for customer portals
To install software updates on customer systems

explanation.correct: Install base management tracks the products and assets that customers own or have installed. This enables agents to see what products a customer has, their configurations, service history, and associated contracts or entitlements.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Plugin management is handled through the ServiceNow platform administration, not install base
Portal configuration is separate from install base management
Install base tracks ownership information, not actual software installation

questions.question: Which role is required to create characteristics for install base items in CSM?

explanation.correct: Only users with the sn_customerservice_manager role can create characteristics for install base items. Administrators can activate the Install Base Characteristics plugin to capture and view characteristics, but the manager role is needed to create them.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Admin can activate the plugin and view characteristics but cannot create them for install base items
Agents can view install base items but cannot create characteristics
The itil role is for ITSM functions, not CSM install base management

source.excerpt: Only users with the sn_customerservice_manager role can create the characteristics for the install base items.

questions.question: Which table stores install base characteristics in Customer Service Management?

explanation.correct: Install base characteristics are stored in the Install Base Characteristics table [sn_install_base_item_characteristic]. Both install base and product model characteristics are displayed in related lists on the install base form.

wrongAnswers.explanation: This is the case table, not where characteristics are stored
This is the main install base item table, characteristics are in a separate table
This is not a standard CSM table for characteristics

source.excerpt: The install base characteristics are stored in the Install Base Characteristics table [sn_install_base_item_characteristic].

questions.question: When the Customer Data Models for B2B2C plugin is activated, which role is automatically inherited by customer service agents?

explanation.correct: When the Customer Data Models for B2B2C plugin is activated, customer service agents inherit the account consumer agent role (sn_acct_consumer.agent). Consumers who are added as account consumers receive the sn_acct_consumer.consumer role.

wrongAnswers.explanation: This role is given to consumers who are added as account consumers, not agents
The manager role is not automatically inherited from B2B2C activation
The admin role is never automatically inherited from plugin activation

source.excerpt: When the plugin is activated, customer service agents inherit the account consumer agent role.

questions.question: What is the B2B2E business model in Customer Service Management?

explanation.correct: B2B2E stands for Business-to-Business-to-Employee. This model is used when a company provides services to another business's employees, such as a benefits provider serving employees of client companies.

wrongAnswers.explanation: The 'E' in B2B2E specifically refers to Employees, not Everyone
Enterprise is not correct; the model focuses on employees as end users
Environment is not a valid expansion for B2B2E

questions.question: What is the purpose of the product model in CSM?

options.text: To define the organizational hierarchy of customer accounts
To define what products a company sells, including attributes and configurations
To model customer service agent performance metrics
To configure the visual layout of the customer portal

explanation.correct: Product models define what products a company sells, including their attributes, configurations, and relationships. Product model characteristics are non-configurable and directly taken from the product model associated with an install base item.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Account hierarchies are defined through account relationships, not product models
Agent performance is tracked through Analytics, not product models
Portal layouts are configured through Service Portal Designer

questions.question: What determines the services a customer can access in CSM?

options.text: User roles assigned to the customer
The number of cases they have created

explanation.correct: Contracts and entitlements determine what services a customer can access and under what conditions. Entitlements define service levels, support hours, and specific service features available to customers based on their contracts.

wrongAnswers.explanation: User roles control system access, not service entitlements for customers
While location may affect service delivery, entitlements are determined by contracts
Case count does not determine service access

questions.question: Which items are installed with the Customer Data Models for B2B2C plugin? (Choose 2)

options.text: Business rules: Mandatory account or consumer
Flow Designer templates for case escalation
UI policies for Case, Interaction, Sold Product, and Install Base Items tables
Custom mobile application for B2B2C users

explanation.correct: The Customer Data Models for B2B2C plugin installs business rules including 'Mandatory account or consumer' and UI policies for the Case, Interaction, Sold Product, and Install Base Items tables to support the B2B2C data model.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Flow Designer templates are not included with the B2B2C plugin installation
No custom mobile application is included with the B2B2C plugin

source.excerpt: Business rules: Mandatory account or consumer, UI policies for Table: Case, Table: Interaction, Table: Sold Product, Table: Install Base Items

questions.question: On which portals can users view install base characteristics associated with parent install base items?

options.text: Customer Service, Consumer Service, and Business Location Service Portal

explanation.correct: Install base characteristics can be viewed on the Customer Service Portal, Consumer Service Portal, and Business Location Service Portal (BLSP). Note that characteristics associated with child items are not visible on the portals.

wrongAnswers.explanation: The IT Service Portal is for ITSM, not CSM install base viewing
The Employee Service Center is for HR Service Delivery
Install base viewing is not available on all portals by default

source.excerpt: You can view the install base characteristics on the Customer Service, Consumer Service, and Business Location Service Portal (BLSP).

questions.question: What is the relationship between a sold product and a contract in CSM?

options.text: Sold products and contracts are unrelated concepts
A sold product can be associated with a service contract to define entitlements
A contract automatically creates sold products
Contracts replace the need for sold products

explanation.correct: A sold product can be associated with a service contract to define the customer's entitlements for that product. This relationship enables tracking what services and support levels the customer is entitled to for specific products.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Sold products and contracts work together to define service entitlements
Contracts don't automatically create sold products; they are linked separately
Both sold products and contracts are used together in CSM

questions.question: A telecommunications company sells phones to retail stores, which then sell to individual consumers. What CSM business model should be implemented?

explanation.correct: B2B2C (Business-to-Business-to-Consumer) is the correct model when a company sells through business partners (retail stores) to reach individual consumers. This model allows tracking of both the business relationship and the end consumer.

wrongAnswers.explanation: B2C would only work if selling directly to consumers without retail partners
B2B only covers the relationship with the retail stores, not the end consumers
B2B2E is for serving employees of partner businesses, not consumers

questions.question: What script modification is required to enable internal users (sys_user) as Unified Consumer users in CSM?

options.text: Modify the sys_user table directly to add consumer flag
Update the Consumer script include to add sys_user to userExtensions
Create a new UI policy on the consumer form
Add the consumer role to sys_user through Access Control

explanation.correct: To enable internal users as Unified Consumer users, you must update the Consumer script include and add sys_user to the userExtensions array in the initialize method. This allows sys_users to be included in the consumer reference list.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Direct table modification is not the correct approach
UI policies control form behavior, not user extension configuration
Role assignment doesn't configure the user extension relationship

source.excerpt: Add the initialize method to the Consumer script include and set this.userExtensions value to include sys_user

questions.question: Which types of install base characteristics exist in CSM?

explanation.correct: Install base items have two types of characteristics: configurable characteristics that vary from product to product, and non-configurable product model characteristics that are directly taken from the associated product model.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Both configurable and product model characteristics exist
Configurable characteristics also exist alongside product model characteristics
The correct terminology is configurable vs non-configurable (product model)

source.excerpt: Some install base characteristics are configurable and vary from product to product. The product model characteristics are non-configurable.

questions.question: In a B2B2C data model, which record type represents the end user who actually uses the product or service?

explanation.correct: In the B2B2C model, the Consumer record represents the end user. The business customer (Account) sells to or supports their consumers, and ServiceNow CSM tracks these consumers separately from the business contacts.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Account represents the business customer, not the end consumer in B2B2C.
Contact is associated with a business account. The Consumer record is the correct entity for end users in B2B2C.
Partner is not a standard CSM data model entity for end users.

questions.question: What is the purpose of an install base item in CSM?

options.text: To track software licenses across the organization
To represent a specific product or service instance owned or used by a customer
To manage the installation process for new software
To store the customer's IT infrastructure configuration

explanation.correct: Install base items represent specific instances of products or services that a customer owns or uses. They enable tracking of service requirements, warranties, and maintenance needs for individual customer assets.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Software license management is handled by SAM, not install base items in CSM.
Install base items track existing product instances, not the installation process itself.
IT infrastructure is tracked in the CMDB. Install base items are customer-facing product/service instances.

questions.question: A customer has a service contract that covers multiple products. Each product has specific support entitlements. How are entitlements associated in the CSM data model?

options.text: Entitlements can only be associated with accounts, not individual products
Entitlements are associated with service contracts and can be linked to specific products, assets, or accounts
Each product must have its own separate service contract
Entitlements are automatically created when a product is added to the CMDB

explanation.correct: Service entitlements can be associated with a product, an asset, an account, or a contract. A single service contract can include multiple entitlements covering different products or services.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Entitlements can be associated with products, assets, accounts, and contracts — not just accounts.
A single contract can include multiple service entitlements for different products.
Entitlements are manually configured and associated — they are not automatically created from CMDB entries.

questions.question: What does the 'Remaining Units' field on a service entitlement track?

options.text: The number of agents available to work on cases
The number of remaining cases or hours available under the entitlement
The remaining days until the entitlement expires
The number of products still covered under the contract

explanation.correct: Entitlements are counted on a per-unit basis. The Unit field defines whether units are cases or hours. The Remaining Units field tracks how many cases or hours remain and is updated by business rules when cases are closed.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Agent availability is managed through assignment workbench, not entitlement units.
Contract expiration is tracked by date fields on the contract, not the Remaining Units field.
Product coverage is defined by entitlement associations, not the Remaining Units counter.

questions.question: Which role is required to create install base characteristics in CSM?

explanation.correct: Only users with the sn_customerservice_manager role can create install base characteristics. Administrators can activate the Install Base Characteristics plugin, but creating the characteristics requires the manager role.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Admin can activate the plugin but creating characteristics requires the sn_customerservice_manager role.
Agents can view and use characteristics but cannot create them.
The itil role is for ITSM, not CSM install base management.

questions.question: Which of the following can a service contract in CSM include? (Choose two.)

explanation.correct: A service contract can include multiple service entitlements and multiple SLAs. It can also include accounts, contacts, or consumers and specify covered assets.

wrongAnswers.explanation: A contract can include multiple SLAs, not just one.
A contract can include an account and contact OR a consumer — it supports both entity types.
